conservative.requirements: 3 favour (with no opportunity to curry additional favour). Play in response to yourself or an ally within medium range failing a Fear or Terror check. Special: If you have Leadership trained, this blessing affects yourself and all allies who have failed a Fear or Terror check from the same source. If you have Discipline trained, affected characters add {Dm} to the new Fear or Terror check. Effect: When you or an ally within medium range fails a Fear or Terror check, you may immediately spend 3 favour and place 4 recharge tokens on this card. That character may attempt the Fear or Terror check again.
